sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Memphis, Tennessee is home to many historic landmarks, like Graceland and Beale Street.
sentences.zh: 田纳西州孟菲斯市拥有许多历史地标，比如雅园和比尔街。

sentences.en: But one of their biggest tourist magnets is a Bass Pro shop.
sentences.zh: 但他们最大的旅游磁石之一却是一家户外用品店——巴斯户外商店（Bass Pro Shop）。

sentences.en: Usually, Bass Pro is the place to buy hunting and fishing gear.
sentences.zh: 通常，巴斯户外商店是购买狩猎和钓鱼装备的地方。

sentences.en: Bass producer Chris Berube.
sentences.zh: 巴斯制作人克里斯·贝鲁比。

sentences.en: But the one in Memphis, it's less of a store and more of a camo-colored amusement park.
sentences.zh: 但孟菲斯的那家店，与其说是一家商店，不如说是一个迷彩色的游乐园。

sentences.en: On the main floor, there are fiberglass cypress trees that are about 100 feet tall, and there's an enclosure with baby alligators.
sentences.zh: 在一楼，有大约100英尺高的玻璃纤维柏树，还有一个养着小短吻鳄的围栏。

sentences.en: They have a fake swamp that is filled with real fish, and a crossbow range, and an arcade where kids can take target practice with plastic guns,
sentences.zh: 他们有一个装满真鱼的假沼泽，一个弩箭靶场，还有一个可以让孩子们用塑料枪进行射击练习的游乐厅，

sentences.en: which gave this pacifist Canadian a few moments of pause.
sentences.zh: 这让身为和平主义者的加拿大人我感到了一丝不安。

sentences.en: Across the way, I see a man showing his infant child how to load a gun.
sentences.zh: 在对面，我看到一个男人正在教他年幼的孩子如何装弹。

sentences.en: It's a little unnerving.
sentences.zh: 这让人有点心神不宁。

sentences.en: It can feel completely surreal to be inside the Memphis Bass Pro.
sentences.zh: 置身于孟菲斯的巴斯户外商店，感觉非常超现实。

sentences.en: And making it double strange is the fact that the store itself is a 32-story stainless steel pyramid.
sentences.zh: 更奇怪的是，这家店本身就是一座32层高的不锈钢金字塔。

sentences.en: The giant pyramid is hard to miss.
sentences.zh: 这座巨大的金字塔很难让人忽视。

sentences.en: The building itself is about two-thirds the height of the Pyramids of Giza.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑本身的高度大约是吉萨金字塔的三分之二。

sentences.en: And the base is about the size of three Walmarts.
sentences.zh: 底座大约有三个沃尔玛超市那么大。

sentences.en: It is the first thing you see driving into Memphis on Interstate 40.
sentences.zh: 它是你沿40号州际公路开车进入孟菲斯时看到的第一样东西。

sentences.en: On one side, you have, you know, glass office towers, typical downtown stuff.
sentences.zh: 一边是玻璃办公大楼，典型的市中心景象。

sentences.en: And then the other side, wham, giant pyramid covered in reflective stainless steel panels and a Bass Pro logo that's over 75 feet tall.
sentences.zh: 而另一边，砰，一座巨大的金字塔，覆盖着反光不锈钢板，还有一个超过75英尺高的巴斯户外商店标志。

sentences.en: I went to check out the pyramid earlier this year, and for journalism purposes, I actually stayed inside a hotel connected to the pyramid.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，我去参观了这座金字塔，为了新闻报道，我实际上住进了与金字塔相连的一家酒店。

sentences.en: It's rustically called the Big Cypress Lodge.
sentences.zh: 它被质朴地称为“大柏树旅馆”。

sentences.en: My room had three pieces of taxidermy and no windows,
sentences.zh: 我的房间里有三个动物标本，没有窗户，

sentences.en: unless you count this little deck area that overlooks the sales floor.
sentences.zh: 除非你算上那个可以俯瞰卖场的小露台区域。

sentences.en: It's got two chairs, two rocking chairs, mosquito netting,
sentences.zh: 那里有两把椅子，两把摇椅，还有蚊帐，

sentences.en: in case mosquitoes come in from the Bass Pro Shop, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想，是以防蚊子从巴斯户外商店飞进来吧。

sentences.en: I would look out onto the bustling store
sentences.zh: 我会眺望熙熙攘攘的商店，

sentences.en: and then stare in awe at the spire of this giant pyramid,
sentences.zh: 然后敬畏地凝视着这座巨大金字塔的尖顶，

sentences.en: hundreds of feet up.
sentences.zh: 几百英尺高。

sentences.en: The Memphis Pyramid hasn't always been a Bass Pro.
sentences.zh: 孟菲斯金字塔并不总是巴斯户外商店。

sentences.en: 35 years ago, civic leaders in Memphis had a totally different plan for it,
sentences.zh: 35年前，孟菲斯的市政领导人对它有着完全不同的规划，

sentences.en: and it's had a few tenants over the years before becoming a woodsy mall.
sentences.zh: 在成为森林风格的购物中心之前，它多年来换过几任租户。

sentences.en: The story of the Great American Pyramid is long and completely bizarre,
sentences.zh: “伟大的美国金字塔”的故事漫长且极其离奇，

sentences.en: and its trajectory shows how, in architecture and urban planning,
sentences.zh: 它的轨迹展示了在建筑和城市规划中，

sentences.en: the life of a building can be impossible to predict.
sentences.zh: 一栋建筑的命运是多么难以预测。

sentences.en: It might sound ridiculous to build a pyramid in modern times,
sentences.zh: 在现代建造金字塔听起来可能很荒谬，

sentences.en: let alone building one in a major American city.
sentences.zh: 更不用说在美国大城市里建造一座了。

sentences.en: But for the past 200 years,
sentences.zh: 但在过去的200年里，

sentences.en: every Western power has borrowed design ideas from ancient Egypt.
sentences.zh: 每一个西方大国都从古埃及借用了设计理念。

sentences.en: After the French invasion of Egypt in 1798,
sentences.zh: 1798年法国入侵埃及之后，

sentences.en: where you can see a lot of influence in architecture, art, furnishings, and so forth.
sentences.zh: 你在建筑、艺术、家具等方面都能看到很多影响。

sentences.en: Dr. Chris Elliott is an Egyptologist
sentences.zh: 克里斯·埃利奥特博士是一位埃及古物学家，

sentences.en: who's currently a visiting fellow at the University of Southampton.
sentences.zh: 目前是南安普顿大学的访问学者。

sentences.en: He says you could see Egyptian designs everywhere in the architecture and the monuments of Western Europe in the 18th and 19th centuries.
sentences.zh: 他说，在18世纪和19世纪的西欧建筑和纪念碑中，随处可见埃及设计。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm fond of paraphrasing the famous lines from Jane Austen's Pride and Prejudice.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我喜欢套用简·奥斯汀《傲慢与偏见》中的名句。

sentences.en: You know, it appears that any nation in possession of an empire must be in want of an obelisk.
sentences.zh: 你知道，似乎任何拥有帝国的国家都必然需要一座方尖碑。

sentences.en: That trend was called Egyptomania, and it jumped over to America in the 19th century.
sentences.zh: 这种趋势被称为“埃及热”，并在19世纪传到了美国。

sentences.en: Designers were putting sphinx heads on chairs
sentences.zh: 设计师们把狮身人面像的头放在椅子上，

sentences.en: and designing public buildings with faux Egyptian accents.
sentences.zh: 并设计带有仿埃及风格装饰的公共建筑。

sentences.en: I think part of this was showing that you weren't just nouveau riche.
sentences.zh: 我认为这部分是为了表明你不仅仅是暴发户。

sentences.en: You were traveled, you were educated, you had taste as well.
sentences.zh: 你游历广泛，受过教育，而且有品位。

sentences.en: You can also see Egyptomania in public buildings,
sentences.zh: 你也可以在公共建筑中看到“埃及热”，

sentences.en: like courthouses and city halls that are made to look Egyptian.
sentences.zh: 比如法院和市政厅，它们被设计成埃及风格。

sentences.en: The Washington Monument?
sentences.zh: 华盛顿纪念碑？

sentences.en: That's just one big old Egyptian obelisk.
sentences.zh: 那不过是一座巨大的古埃及方尖碑。

sentences.en: The city of Memphis, Tennessee is perhaps the peak of this trend.
sentences.zh: 田纳西州的孟菲斯市或许是这种趋势的巅峰。

sentences.en: Memphis was named after the capital of ancient Egypt,
sentences.zh: 孟菲斯是以古埃及首都的名字命名的，

sentences.en: and the city's founders picked the name because Memphis, Tennessee
sentences.zh: 城市创始人选择这个名字是因为孟菲斯（田纳西州）

sentences.en: is nestled beside America's most powerful river, the Mississippi.
sentences.zh: 坐落在美洲最强大的河流——密西西比河畔。

sentences.en: There's this longstanding tradition of the Mississippi as the American Nile.
sentences.zh: 密西西比河作为“美国尼罗河”的传统由来已久。

sentences.en: Apart from anyone else, Abraham Lincoln actually used that metaphor.
sentences.zh: 除了别人，亚伯拉罕·林肯实际上也用过这个比喻。

sentences.en: So naturally, the city of Memphis needed its own big ancient Egyptian attraction.
sentences.zh: 所以自然地，孟菲斯市需要它自己宏伟的古埃及景点。

sentences.en: Obelisk was kind of taken because, you know, the Washington Monument.
sentences.zh: 方尖碑因为华盛顿纪念碑的缘故被占用了。

sentences.en: So instead, they went with a pyramid.
sentences.zh: 所以他们选择了金字塔。

sentences.en: A wooden pyramid was constructed in 1897 to represent the city at the Centennial Fair in Nashville.
sentences.zh: 1897年，人们建造了一座木制金字塔，以代表该市参加纳什维尔的百年博览会。

sentences.en: The wooden pyramid wasn't used for anything after the fair, so they tore it down.
sentences.zh: 博览会结束后，这座木制金字塔就没用了，所以他们把它拆了。

sentences.en: But a local artist revived the pyramid idea about a half a century later.
sentences.zh: 但大约半个世纪后，一位当地艺术家复兴了金字塔的想法。

sentences.en: In the 1950s, this artist named Mark Hartz drew up a plan for three pyramids.
sentences.zh: 20世纪50年代，这位名叫马克·哈茨的艺术家绘制了一份建造三座金字塔的计划。

sentences.en: This is Martha Park, a local author and illustrator who has written about the Memphis Pyramid.
sentences.zh: 这是玛莎·帕克，一位写过关于孟菲斯金字塔的当地作家和插画家。

sentences.en: They would be bronze-colored along the riverfront, and they would be like two-thirds the size of the pyramids in Giza.
sentences.zh: 它们将是青铜色的，坐落在河岸边，大小约为吉萨金字塔的三分之二。

sentences.en: The trio of bronze pyramids were never built.
sentences.zh: 这三座青铜金字塔从未建成。

sentences.en: But over the years, the idea of a permanent gigantic pyramid for downtown Memphis stuck around.
sentences.zh: 但多年来，为孟菲斯市中心建造一座永久性巨型金字塔的想法一直存在，

sentences.en: especially among civic leaders who wanted outsiders to think of Memphis
sentences.zh: 特别是在那些希望外地人想到孟菲斯时，

sentences.en: for something other than Elvis and the Blues.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅想到猫王和蓝调音乐的市政领导人中间。

sentences.en: I think it's this kind of attempt to have this, like, monolithic representation of the city,
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种试图拥有某种代表城市的标志性建筑的尝试，

sentences.en: like the Bean in Chicago, the Arch in St. Louis.
sentences.zh: 就像芝加哥的“豆子”，圣路易斯的拱门一样。

sentences.en: It will just mean Memphis to other people's brains.
sentences.zh: 它在别人的脑海中就代表了孟菲斯。

sentences.en: For years, the pyramid was just this quirky, unrealized civic project.
sentences.zh: 多年来，金字塔只是一个古怪的、未实现的市政项目。

sentences.en: But in the mid-80s, the planets finally lined up.
sentences.zh: 但在80年代中期，时机终于成熟了。

sentences.en: The city needed a new downtown landmark.
sentences.zh: 这座城市需要一个新的市中心地标。

sentences.en: The college basketball team, the Memphis Tigers, were selling out all of their home games, and they needed a bigger arena.
sentences.zh: 大学篮球队“孟菲斯老虎队”的主场比赛场场爆满，他们需要一个更大的竞技场。

sentences.en: At the same time, it was the peak of postmodernism in American architecture.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，那是美国建筑界后现代主义的巅峰时期。

sentences.en: Cities all over the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国各地的城市

sentences.en: were commissioning buildings that borrowed details from Greece, ancient Rome, and yes, ancient Egypt.
sentences.zh: 都在委托建造借鉴希腊、古罗马，当然还有古埃及细节的建筑。

sentences.en: So city and county officials formed a public building authority
sentences.zh: 于是市和县的官员成立了一个公共建筑管理局，

sentences.en: and announced they would spend $39 million on a brand new basketball arena
sentences.zh: 并宣布将斥资3900万美元建造一座全新的篮球馆，

sentences.en: in the shape of a giant pyramid.
sentences.zh: 形状就是一座巨大的金字塔。

sentences.en: The Memphis Building Authority chose to construct the pyramid
sentences.zh: 孟菲斯建筑管理局选择用不锈钢而不是青铜来建造金字塔。

sentences.en: with stainless steel instead of bronze.
sentences.zh: 并选择了该市历史悠久的平奇区作为地点。

sentences.en: And it picked a location in the city's historic Pinch District.
sentences.zh: 平奇（Pinch）这个名字源于19世纪60年代爱尔兰马铃薯饥荒时期来到这里的爱尔兰移民。

sentences.en: Pinch was named from the Irish settlers that came in from the Irish potato famine in the 1860s.
sentences.zh: 被称为“平奇肠区”（Pinch Gut District），因为他们的胃部看起来像瘦子一样凹陷。

sentences.en: The Pinch Gut District because their stomachs had the pinched-in look like a skinny man.
sentences.zh: 那是吉米·奥格尔。

sentences.en: That's Jimmy Ogle.
sentences.zh: 他曾是谢尔比县的官方历史学家，该县包括孟菲斯。

sentences.en: He used to be the official historian for Shelby County, which includes Memphis.
sentences.zh: 他说，平奇区在20世纪60年代被一条高速公路一分为二之前，经历过几波移民潮。

sentences.en: He says the Pinch District had gone through waves of immigration before it was basically cut in half by a highway in the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 那是在城市更新之后，但60年代所有城市都在进行城市更新，我们在很多方面称之为“城市清除”。

sentences.en: It was after urban renewal, but all that was going on in the 60s with the urban renewal of all cities, and we called it urban removal in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 城市领导人认为金字塔可以帮助振兴经济，并将更多人带到孟菲斯市中心。

sentences.en: City leaders felt the pyramid could help rejuvenate the economy and bring more people into downtown Memphis.
sentences.zh: 此外，平奇区有一大片土地紧邻密西西比河，

sentences.en: Plus, there was this big tract of land in the Pinch right alongside the Mississippi River,
sentences.zh: 那条传说中的美国尼罗河。

sentences.en: the fabled Nile of America.
sentences.zh: 1988年，市和县投票决定用公共资金在平奇区建造金字塔。

sentences.en: In 1988, the city and county voted to build the pyramid in the Pinch District with public money.
sentences.zh: 竞技场将为该社区注入活力。

sentences.en: The arena would give the neighborhood a shot in the arm.
sentences.zh: 它将为老虎队提供额外的10,000个座位。

sentences.en: It would give the Tigers another 10,000 seats.
sentences.zh: 它将为这座城市提供它一直梦寐以求的金字塔形巨石建筑。

sentences.en: And it would give the city the pyramid-shaped monolith it had always dreamed of.
sentences.zh: 金字塔形状的一个独特之处在于，竞技场周围会有很多未使用的空间。

sentences.en: A unique aspect of the pyramid's shape is that it would have a lot of unused space around the arena.
sentences.zh: 而所有这些空间吸引了几个有进取心的商人。

sentences.en: And all this space attracted a couple of enterprising businessmen.
sentences.zh: 一位名叫约翰·蒂格雷特的当地企业家帮助说服了市政府建造金字塔，部分原因是他想参与经营。

sentences.en: A local entrepreneur named John Tigrett helped convince the city to build the pyramid, partly because he wanted to help run it.
sentences.zh: 蒂格雷特以拥有在水杯中上下浮动的“饮水鸭”玩具的专利而闻名，此外还有其他更严肃的商业投资。

sentences.en: Tigrett was famous for owning the patent on the drinky duck toy that bobs up and down in a glass of water, among other more serious business ventures.
sentences.zh: 但在20世纪80年代，他将金字塔视为一个巨大的机会。

sentences.en: But in the 1980s, he saw the pyramid as a great opportunity.
sentences.zh: 蒂格雷特有兴趣在建筑内建造一些景点。

sentences.en: Tigert was interested in building some attractions inside the building.
sentences.zh: 为了实现这一点，蒂格雷特招募了另一位名叫西德尼·施伦克的商人。

sentences.en: To help with this, Tigert recruited another businessman named Sidney Schlenker.
sentences.zh: 施伦克曾帮助开设了休斯顿的太空穹顶体育馆，

sentences.en: Schlenker had helped open the Astrodome in Houston,
sentences.zh: 他还是丹佛掘金篮球队的老板。

sentences.en: and he was the owner of the Denver Nuggets basketball team.
sentences.zh: 他是个疯狂的混蛋。

sentences.en: He was a crazy bastard.
sentences.zh: 他还没完成第一个想法就开始了第二个。

sentences.en: He couldn't finish his first idea before starting the second.
sentences.zh: 拉斯·西蒙斯是90年代初孟菲斯金字塔的总经理。

sentences.en: Russ Simons was the general manager of the Memphis Pyramid in the early 90s.
sentences.zh: 他说西德尼·施伦克是一位非常有热情的推销员。

sentences.en: And he says Sidney Schlenker was a very enthusiastic salesman.
sentences.zh: 他是个天才。

sentences.en: He was a genius.
sentences.zh: 他必须是，你知道，在推销能力方面可能仅次于巴纳姆。

sentences.en: He had to be, you know, probably just below Barnum in terms of his ability to sell.
sentences.zh: 我会把他排在P.T.巴纳姆之后半个身位。

sentences.en: I'd put him a half step below P.T.
sentences.zh: 蒂格雷特和施伦克与市政府达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: Barnum.
sentences.zh: 基本上，市和县将用公共资金建造金字塔，

sentences.en: Tigrant and Schlenker struck a deal with the city.
sentences.zh: 而商人们将在整栋建筑中安装价值2000万美元的景点。

sentences.en: Basically, the city and county would construct the pyramid with public funds.
sentences.zh: 施伦克对金字塔有很多想法，

sentences.en: and the businessmen would install $20 million worth of attractions throughout the building.
sentences.zh: 其中许多都在这段方便的宣传视频中总结了出来。

sentences.en: Schlenker had a ton of ideas for the pyramid,
sentences.zh: 一座新的金字塔正在建造，不是为了美化死亡，

sentences.en: many of which are summed up in this handy promotional video.
sentences.zh: 而是作为一座纪念碑，它将歌颂生命和人类不屈不挠的创造精神，

sentences.en: A new pyramid is being built, not to glorify death,
sentences.zh: 去实现一种能够触及星辰并跨越世纪的伟大。

sentences.en: but as a monument that will celebrate life and man's indomitable spirit to create,
sentences.zh: 一种会说“感受伟大的美国金字塔的力量”的伟大。

sentences.en: to achieve a greatness that will reach to the stars and span centuries.
sentences.zh: 我不能播放整个视频，因为它有14分钟长，但这里有一个快速总结。

sentences.en: A greatness that will say, feel the power of the Great American Pyramid.
sentences.zh: 旁白声称金字塔将包括适合全家人的景点，

sentences.en: I can't play this whole video because it's like 14 minutes long, but here's a quick summary.
sentences.zh: 比如音乐名人堂、硬石餐厅、世界上最大的晶体管收音机，

sentences.en: A narrator claims the pyramid would include attractions for the whole family,
sentences.zh: 当然，还有激光表演，为什么不呢？

sentences.en: like a music hall of fame, a hard rock cafe, the world's largest transistor radio,
sentences.zh: 正如古老的金字塔将我们的思绪引向埃及文化一样，

sentences.en: And, sure, why not, a laser show.
sentences.zh: 这座新的金字塔也将成为美国文明精华的名片。

sentences.en: And just as the pyramids of old pull our thoughts to Egyptian culture,
sentences.zh: 金字塔还将设有一个最先进的缆车，称为“倾斜器”。

sentences.en: so too will this new pyramid be a calling card for the best of American civilization.
sentences.zh: “倾斜器”本应是一部沿着建筑侧面以45度角运行的电梯。

sentences.en: The pyramid would also feature a state-of-the-art funicular called the Inclinator.
sentences.zh: 有了“倾斜器”，游客可以前往观景台，惊叹于下方的密西西比河。

sentences.en: The Inclinator was supposed to be an elevator running on a 45-degree incline along the side of the building.
sentences.zh: 炒作非常强烈。

sentences.en: With the Inclinator, tourists could travel to an observation deck and marvel at the Mississippi River below.
sentences.zh: 视频甚至将金字塔与世界上一些最伟大的奇迹进行了比较，

sentences.en: The hype was very strong.
sentences.zh: 比如悉尼歌剧院、凯旋门，甚至吉萨金字塔。

sentences.en: The video even compared the pyramid to some of the greatest wonders of the world,
sentences.zh: 然后，它暗示金字塔可能比所有其他东西都要好。

sentences.en: like the Sydney Opera House and the Arc de Triomphe, and even the Pyramids of Giza.
sentences.zh: 他们让它从屏幕底部升起，然后从后面超越吉萨金字塔画面的方式就像是，忘掉你所知道的关于金字塔的一切吧，

sentences.en: Then, it suggests the pyramid will probably be better than all of those other things.
sentences.zh: 宝贝。

sentences.en: The way that they have it come up from the bottom of the screen and then overtake the picture of the Pyramids of Giza from behind it is like, forget all you know about pyramids,
sentences.zh: 我无法夸大这里承诺了多少东西。

sentences.en: baby.
sentences.zh: 孟菲斯金字塔将是一座完全独特的建筑，一个竞技场、一个博物馆、一个主题公园、一部大电梯，还有十几种其他东西。

sentences.en: I cannot overstate how much stuff was being promised here.
sentences.zh: 对于金字塔的愿景，我只能说它是非凡的。

sentences.en: The Memphis Pyramid would be a totally unique building, an arena and a museum and a theme park and a big elevator and like a dozen other things.
sentences.zh: 如果那个愿景能够实现，它将是世界上独一无二的。

sentences.en: The vision for the pyramid, I'll just say it was extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 市政府于1989年开始建造金字塔，而两位商人则制定了内部规划。

sentences.en: If that vision had been able to be brought to life, it would have been unlike anything else in the world.
sentences.zh: 蒂格雷特和施伦克告诉公众，他们将在金字塔和周边社区投入数百万美元。

sentences.en: The city began construction on the pyramid in 1989, while the two businessmen drew up plans for what to put inside.
sentences.zh: （注：此条目为补全编号，内容为空）

sentences.en: Tigrett and Schlenker told the public they were going to spend millions of dollars on the pyramid and the surrounding neighborhood.
sentences.zh: （注：此条目为补全编号，内容为空）

sentences.en: But it slowly became clear that their plans weren't the most realistic,
sentences.zh: 但慢慢地人们发现，他们的计划并不怎么现实，

sentences.en: at least not at the scale they had promised.
sentences.zh: 至少在他们承诺的规模上是这样。

sentences.en: Schlenker commissioned the inclinator,
sentences.zh: 施伦克（Schlenker）委托建造了斜升电梯（Inclinator），

sentences.en: but he didn't have enough money to mount it on the side of the building,
sentences.zh: 但他没有足够的钱将其安装在建筑外侧，

sentences.en: and it was abandoned.
sentences.zh: 于是这个项目就被废弃了。

sentences.en: Pretty soon, their struggles became obvious to the people of Memphis.
sentences.zh: 很快，他们的困境在孟菲斯人眼中变得显而易见。

sentences.en: If you talk to people in Memphis about Sidney Schlenker,
sentences.zh: 如果你和孟菲斯人谈起西德尼·施伦克（Sidney Schlenker），

sentences.en: it's very like, Schlenker.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，施伦克。

sentences.en: You know, it's like this kind of Newman kind of pronunciation.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像那种纽曼式的发音。

sentences.en: In the end, Schlinker and Tigrit had a public falling out.
sentences.zh: 最终，施伦克和蒂格里特（Tigrit）公开闹翻了。

sentences.en: Their pyramid company filed for bankruptcy, and the city took them off the project altogether.
sentences.zh: 他们的金字塔公司申请了破产，市政府也将他们彻底踢出了项目。

sentences.en: The pyramid's construction was finished in 1991.
sentences.zh: 金字塔的建设于1991年完工。

sentences.en: The actual building was completed without Tigrit and Schlinker because the construction, that was largely paid for by public money.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑最终是在没有蒂格里特和施伦克参与的情况下完成的，因为建设费用主要由公共资金支付。

sentences.en: When the pyramid opened, it was the largest pyramid in America, and by some estimates, the sixth largest pyramid on Earth.
sentences.zh: 金字塔开放时，它是美国最大的金字塔，据估计也是全球第六大金字塔。

sentences.en: But the project was over budget, costing the public $65 million instead of $39 million.
sentences.zh: 但该项目超出了预算，花费了公众6500万美元，而不是最初的3900万美元。

sentences.en: And it didn't have any theme parks or laser shows or even the famed Inclinator.
sentences.zh: 而且它没有主题公园、激光表演，甚至连著名的斜升电梯都没有。

sentences.en: In the end, it was just an arena.
sentences.zh: 到头来，它仅仅是一个竞技场。

sentences.en: The Pyramid opened to great fanfare in November 1991.
sentences.zh: 金字塔于1991年11月盛大开幕。

sentences.en: But it was clear there were some unusual kinks to work out.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，还有一些不同寻常的问题需要解决。

sentences.en: Take, for example, what happened on opening night,
sentences.zh: 以开幕当晚发生的事情为例，

sentences.en: when country music legends Naomi and Winona Judd
sentences.zh: 当时乡村音乐传奇人物娜奥米（Naomi）和威诺娜·贾德（Winona Judd）

sentences.en: played a concert to launch the new venue.
sentences.zh: 举办了一场音乐会来为新场馆揭幕。

sentences.en: Russ Simons was the general manager at the time,
sentences.zh: 拉斯·西蒙斯（Russ Simons）当时是总经理，

sentences.en: and he says one aspect of the building
sentences.zh: 他说建筑有一个方面

sentences.en: that wasn't ready on opening night
sentences.zh: 在开幕当晚还没准备好，

sentences.en: was the plumbing system.
sentences.zh: 那就是管道系统。

sentences.en: The pyramid sits below grade,
sentences.zh: 金字塔位于地平面以下，

sentences.en: sits right on the level of the river.
sentences.zh: 正好处于河流的水位线上。

sentences.en: The plumbing designer had,
sentences.zh: 管道设计师当时，

sentences.en: we were supposed to have two 3,000-gallon-per-minute
sentences.zh: 我们本应拥有两台每分钟3000加仑的

sentences.en: lift stations to lift sewage.
sentences.zh: 提升泵站来提升污水。

sentences.en: Look, there's a very technical explanation for all this,
sentences.zh: 听着，这一切都有非常专业的技术解释，

sentences.en: but basically the toilets overflowed
sentences.zh: 但基本上就是厕所溢水了，

sentences.en: and immediately flooded the building.
sentences.zh: 并立即淹没了整座建筑。

sentences.en: Russ remembers how, despite all this,
sentences.zh: 拉斯记得，尽管发生了这一切，

sentences.en: the Judds heroically got on stage
sentences.zh: 贾德母女还是英勇地登上了舞台，

sentences.en: and they still did their show.
sentences.zh: 并坚持完成了演出。

sentences.en: So myself and our head of guest experience, Rick Fredette,
sentences.zh: 所以我和我们的宾客体验主管里克·弗雷德特（Rick Fredette），

sentences.en: we used a fireman carry to lift Naomi
sentences.zh: 我们用消防员背人的方式把娜奥米

sentences.en: and Winona Judd to the stage.
sentences.zh: 和威诺娜·贾德送上了舞台。

sentences.en: They had carried their shoes.
sentences.zh: 她们是提着鞋子上去的。

sentences.en: They got on the stairs.
sentences.zh: 她们走上楼梯。

sentences.en: They got their shoes on, sort of told me good luck.
sentences.zh: 穿上鞋子，算是跟我说了声祝你好运。

sentences.en: And they got up there and brought the house lights down
sentences.zh: 然后她们走上去，关掉大厅灯光，

sentences.en: and played their show from beginning to end.
sentences.zh: 从头到尾完成了演出。

sentences.en: And we lost a lot of shoes that night.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我们丢了很多鞋子。

sentences.en: Ross and his team managed to get things cleaned up and they fixed the plumbing.
sentences.zh: 拉斯和他的团队设法清理了现场并修复了管道。

sentences.en: But there was another challenge to using the pyramid as a concert venue.
sentences.zh: 但将金字塔用作音乐会场地还面临另一个挑战。

sentences.en: Most arenas are optimized for sound.
sentences.zh: 大多数竞技场都对音响效果进行了优化。

sentences.en: By contrast, a pyramid shape is less than ideal for concerts.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，金字塔形状对于音乐会来说并不理想。

sentences.en: Here's Martha Park.
sentences.zh: 这是玛莎·帕克（Martha Park）。

sentences.en: The point at the top of the pyramid, it's like all the sound goes straight up, doesn't disperse,
sentences.zh: 金字塔顶端的尖角，就像所有的声音都直冲上去，无法扩散，

sentences.en: and then just goes, whoom, and bounces back down to you.
sentences.zh: 然后就“轰”的一声，反弹回你身上。

sentences.en: Like, acoustically, there's nowhere for the sound to go,
sentences.zh: 从声学上讲，声音无处可去，

sentences.en: except just back and forth.
sentences.zh: 只能来回反射。

sentences.en: And December was Van Halen.
sentences.zh: 十二月是范·海伦（Van Halen）乐队的演出。

sentences.en: That's when they figured out they didn't have enough acoustics in the building.
sentences.zh: 那时他们才发现建筑里的声学效果不够好。

sentences.en: And it was just a nightmare, like having a concert and a racquetball court.
sentences.zh: 那简直是一场噩梦，就像在壁球馆里开演唱会一样。

sentences.en: It's just a terrible sound.
sentences.zh: 声音简直太糟糕了。

sentences.en: After the construction hype and the toilet flood and the big echo,
sentences.zh: 在建设炒作、厕所淹水和大回声之后，

sentences.en: within a few weeks, the pyramid started to find its footing.
sentences.zh: 几周之内，金字塔开始站稳了脚跟。

sentences.en: Russ Simons says his team added more sound baffling.
sentences.zh: 拉斯·西蒙斯说他的团队增加了更多的隔音板。

sentences.en: And Memphians came out in droves.
sentences.zh: 孟菲斯人蜂拥而至。

sentences.en: Of course, to see concerts, but also the arena's major draw, college basketball.
sentences.zh: 当然是为了看演唱会，但也是为了竞技场的主要吸引力——大学篮球。

sentences.en: Here is an exterior look at this stainless steel and glass beauty that now is dominating the skyline.
sentences.zh: 这是这座不锈钢和玻璃建筑的外观，它现在正主宰着天际线。

sentences.en: And certainly the drive along the river here, it holds just over 20,000 and every seat is filled tonight.
sentences.zh: 当然，沿着河边开车，它能容纳两万多人，今晚座无虚席。

sentences.en: In 1992, the college basketball team, the Memphis Tigers, were led by a young phenom named Penny Hardaway.
sentences.zh: 1992年，大学篮球队“孟菲斯老虎队”由一位名叫便士·哈达威（Penny Hardaway）的年轻天才领衔。

sentences.en: They made the NCAA tournament, and their success drew rabid fans to the new stadium, which they nicknamed the Tomb of Doom.
sentences.zh: 他们打进了NCAA锦标赛，他们的成功吸引了狂热的球迷来到这座新体育场，他们将其戏称为“末日之墓”（Tomb of Doom）。

sentences.en: The pyramid became a place to be in Memphis.
sentences.zh: 金字塔成了孟菲斯必去的地方。

sentences.en: The Tigers had great crowds, and the arena drew in big names for concerts like Bruce Springsteen and the Grateful Dead.
sentences.zh: 老虎队拥有很棒的观众，竞技场也吸引了布鲁斯·斯普林斯汀（Bruce Springsteen）和感恩至死（Grateful Dead）乐队等大牌明星来开演唱会。

sentences.en: And later, a prize fight between Mike Tyson and Lennox Lewis.
sentences.zh: 后来还有迈克·泰森（Mike Tyson）和伦诺克斯·刘易斯（Lennox Lewis）之间的冠军争夺战。

sentences.en: After a few years, the management team even started booking events in the unused space,
sentences.zh: 几年后，管理团队甚至开始在闲置空间预订活动，

sentences.en: but on a smaller scale than what was imagined by Schlenker and Tigrit.
sentences.zh: 但规模比施伦克和蒂格里特想象的要小。

sentences.en: They booked an exhibition of artifacts from the Titanic,
sentences.zh: 他们举办了泰坦尼克号文物展，

sentences.en: and yes, a display of treasures from ancient Egypt.
sentences.zh: 还有古埃及珍宝展。

sentences.en: Okay, sure, the Luxor Casino in Las Vegas took away its crown as biggest pyramid in America in 1993,
sentences.zh: 好吧，确实，拉斯维加斯的卢克索赌场（Luxor Casino）在1993年夺走了它作为美国最大金字塔的桂冠，

sentences.en: but that didn't matter.
sentences.zh: 但这并不重要。

sentences.en: All in all, it seemed like the pyramid was becoming a success.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，金字塔似乎正在走向成功。

sentences.en: I wish I could say this is how the story ends, with the pyramid, in spite of everything,
sentences.zh: 我希望我能说故事到此结束，金字塔尽管经历了这一切，

sentences.en: rising in a blaze of steel and fiberglass and ancient Egyptian kitsch to become Memphis' beloved sports arena, living happily ever after.
sentences.zh: 在钢铁、玻璃纤维和古埃及媚俗装饰的辉煌中崛起，成为孟菲斯深受喜爱的体育竞技场，从此过上了幸福的生活。

sentences.en: Of course, this is not what happened next.
sentences.zh: 当然，接下来发生的事情并非如此。

sentences.en: Basketball had made the Memphis pyramid, and a decade later, basketball nearly destroyed it.
sentences.zh: 篮球成就了孟菲斯金字塔，而十年后，篮球也差点毁了它。

sentences.en: Civic leaders in Memphis had always wanted a big league sports franchise.
sentences.zh: 孟菲斯的市民领袖一直想要一支大联盟体育球队。

sentences.en: And in 2001, they finally got their chance.
sentences.zh: 2001年，他们终于等到了机会。

sentences.en: Well, the team's been in the league six years.
sentences.zh: 球队在联盟里待了六年。

sentences.en: And in that time, the Vancouver Grizzlies won 98 games.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，温哥华灰熊队赢了98场比赛。

sentences.en: They lost another 352.
sentences.zh: 输了352场。

sentences.en: So an announcement today that it's applied to move to an American city comes as no surprise.
sentences.zh: 所以今天宣布申请搬迁到美国城市并不令人意外。

sentences.en: The Vancouver Grizzlies were the worst team in the NBA.
sentences.zh: 温哥华灰熊队是NBA最差的球队，

sentences.en: and the city of Vancouver never showed up to the games.
sentences.zh: 而且温哥华市从来没人来看比赛。

sentences.en: In 2001, on short notice,
sentences.zh: 2001年，在短时间内，

sentences.en: the owner of the Grizzlies decided to move them out of Canada and into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 灰熊队的老板决定将他们从加拿大搬到美国。

sentences.en: And with that, the Memphis Grizzlies were born.
sentences.zh: 就这样，孟菲斯灰熊队诞生了。

sentences.en: Though in the great tradition of the Utah Jazz,
sentences.zh: 虽然遵循犹他爵士队的伟大传统，

sentences.en: the name did not make a lot of geographic sense.
sentences.zh: 这个名字在地理上并没有什么意义。

sentences.en: This franchise came from Vancouver.
sentences.zh: 这支球队来自温哥华。

sentences.en: That's why we're named the Grizzlies.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们叫灰熊队。

sentences.en: Where's a grizzly bear around here, you know?
sentences.zh: 这附近哪有灰熊啊，你懂的？

sentences.en: The Grizzlies played their first three seasons in the pyramid.
sentences.zh: 灰熊队在金字塔球馆打了前三个赛季。

sentences.en: But the NBA made it clear that the pyramid could not be a long-term home for the Grizzlies
sentences.zh: 但NBA明确表示，金字塔不能作为灰熊队的长期主场，

sentences.en: because it simply wasn't up to NBA standards.
sentences.zh: 因为它根本达不到NBA的标准。

sentences.en: Basketball arenas were sort of undergoing this evolution.
sentences.zh: 篮球竞技场正在经历这种演变。

sentences.en: Here's Zach McMillan.
sentences.zh: 这是扎克·麦克米兰（Zach McMillan）。

sentences.en: He covered basketball for the Memphis Commercial Appeal.
sentences.zh: 他为《孟菲斯商业呼声报》（Memphis Commercial Appeal）报道篮球新闻。

sentences.en: Zach says in the early 2000s, the business of sports in North America went through a rapid change.
sentences.zh: 扎克说在21世纪初，北美的体育产业经历了快速变革。

sentences.en: You were moving from a time when the point of a basketball arena was to get as many people as you could into the seats, balance supply and demand as best you could.
sentences.zh: 你正从一个篮球竞技场的目的是尽可能多地让观众入座、尽可能平衡供需的时代走出来。

sentences.en: Maybe within five or six years, if you built a new arena, you really put an emphasis on the luxury suites.
sentences.zh: 也许在五六年内，如果你建造一个新的竞技场，你真的会把重点放在豪华包厢上。

sentences.en: You wanted people paying premium prices to rent out those suites.
sentences.zh: 你希望人们支付高昂的价格来租用这些包厢。

sentences.en: And that's really how you could create the business model to make it work.
sentences.zh: 这才是你能够创造商业模式并使其运作的真正方式。

sentences.en: Basketball in North America was becoming a big money sport, and that came with a lot of expectations.
sentences.zh: 北美的篮球正在成为一项高收入运动，随之而来的是许多期望。

sentences.en: Arenas needed luxury boxes.
sentences.zh: 竞技场需要豪华包厢。

sentences.en: They also needed fancy modern training facilities and a massive digital scoreboard and spacious locker rooms and lots of things the Memphis Pyramid lacked.
sentences.zh: 它们还需要现代化的豪华训练设施、巨大的数字记分牌、宽敞的更衣室，以及许多孟菲斯金字塔所缺乏的东西。

sentences.en: So the Grizzlies' ownership made a fateful choice.
sentences.zh: 所以灰熊队的老板做出了一个决定性的选择。

sentences.en: They decided the pyramid wasn't worth the hassle.
sentences.zh: 他们认为金字塔不值得折腾。

sentences.en: A new arena was built using public money, and the FedEx Forum opened in 2004.
sentences.zh: 一座新的竞技场使用公共资金建造，联邦快递广场（FedEx Forum）于2004年开业。

sentences.en: It became the new home for the Grizzlies, and to add insult to injury, it was clearly visible from the pyramid.
sentences.zh: 它成了灰熊队的新主场，而且雪上加霜的是，从金字塔里就能清楚地看到它。

sentences.en: The new arena was much more conventional than the pyramid.
sentences.zh: 新竞技场比金字塔传统得多。

sentences.en: For starters, it was actually arena-shaped.
sentences.zh: 首先，它确实是竞技场的形状。

sentences.en: The fact that it's fun, and it's a building that works well, and the acoustics aren't maddening, and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 它很有趣，是一座功能良好的建筑，音响效果也不让人抓狂，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Soon, the Memphis Tigers also moved to the Forum,
sentences.zh: 很快，孟菲斯老虎队也搬到了广场，

sentences.en: and major concerts started getting booked there too.
sentences.zh: 大型演唱会也开始在那里预订。

sentences.en: There was still an occasional show at the Tomb of Doom,
sentences.zh: “末日之墓”偶尔还会举办演出，

sentences.en: but in 2007, Bob Seger played the last concert ever held there.
sentences.zh: 但在2007年，鲍勃·西格（Bob Seger）在那里举办了最后一场演唱会。

sentences.en: The Memphis Pyramid went from being a center of civic life
sentences.zh: 孟菲斯金字塔从市民生活的中心，

sentences.en: to having zero tenants and zero prospects.

sentences.zh: 罗曼，整件事会让你大吃一惊。

sentences.en: So Isaac had access while it was being built.
sentences.zh: 就像金字塔的其他一切一样，这是最疯狂的可能性。

sentences.en: And when nobody was looking, he snuck in and he went up to the top of the pyramid and he hid a good luck charm in the rafters.
sentences.zh: 这个故事是我从拉斯·西蒙斯那里听来的，你可能还记得他是 90 年代金字塔的前任总经理。

sentences.en: And he never told anybody.
sentences.zh: 艾萨克·蒂格雷特召集了一群人。

sentences.en: Oh, a good luck charm.
sentences.zh: 不知怎么地拉拢了一名保安，他们带着梯子、焊接设备和所有需要的东西，爬上了那 422 级台阶，到达了观景台。

sentences.en: Okay, tell me about it.
sentences.zh: 他们焊接了一个和钢材颜色一样的盒子，

sentences.en: So, Roman, this whole thing is going to blow your mind.
sentences.zh: 他们把它焊在那里，就在金字塔汇合点的正中央。

sentences.en: Like everything else with the pyramid, it's the wildest of possibilities.
sentences.zh: 拉斯当时在管理金字塔，做着管理工作，

sentences.en: So I heard this story from Russ Simons, who you may remember was the former general manager of the pyramid in the 90s.
sentences.zh: 他环顾四周，注意到了这个盒子，

sentences.en: Isaac Tigrett got a group of people together.
sentences.zh: 他心想，好吧，这东西不应该在那儿。

sentences.en: Somehow co-opted a security guard and they took ladders and welding equipment and everything they needed to take up those 422 steps up to the observation deck.
sentences.zh: 这是什么？

sentences.en: and they welded a box that was the same color as the steel
sentences.zh: 我带着工人们、往复锯、我们的设备，

sentences.en: and they welded it and it was like directly in the center
sentences.zh: 还有梯子。

sentences.en: of how the pyramid comes together.
sentences.zh: 我们爬上那些台阶，

sentences.en: So Russ is running the pyramid, he's doing management stuff
sentences.zh: 我们敲掉了焊点，把盒子取了下来。

sentences.en: and, you know, he looks around and he notices this box
sentences.zh: 拉斯和他的团队取下了这个盒子。

sentences.en: and he's thinking like, okay, that shouldn't be there.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不知道是艾萨克·蒂格雷特放的。

sentences.en: Like, what is this?
sentences.zh: 他们心想，这危险吗？

sentences.en: I got my workers and sawzalls and our equipment,
sentences.zh: 这个神秘盒子到底是什么？

sentences.en: all that and ladders.
sentences.zh: 所以他们做的第一件事就是打电话给市政府和县政府，对方说，我们会派代表过去。

sentences.en: We traipsed up those steps
sentences.zh: 于是大家都聚在一起。

sentences.en: And we went and we knocked the welds off and we brought the box down.
sentences.zh: 他们看着这个盒子，决定说，好吧，我们把它打开看看里面有什么。

sentences.en: So Russ and his team, they take down this box.
sentences.zh: 我们带上工作人员，敲开了盒子的盖子。

sentences.en: They have no idea Isaac Tigard has put it there.
sentences.zh: 我们带上工作人员，敲开了盒子的盖子。

sentences.en: And they're thinking, like, is this dangerous?
sentences.zh: 我们带上工作人员，敲开了盒子的盖子。

sentences.en: Like, what is this mystery box?
sentences.zh: 我们带上工作人员，敲开了盒子的盖子。

sentences.en: So the first thing they do is they actually call the city and the county who are like, we'll send some representatives over.
sentences.zh: 我们带上工作人员，敲开了盒子的盖子。

sentences.en: So everybody gathers around.
sentences.zh: 我们带上工作人员，敲开了盒子的盖子。

sentences.en: They're looking at this box and they all decide, OK, look, let's just open it up and let's just see what's inside.
sentences.zh: 我们带上工作人员，敲开了盒子的盖子。

sentences.en: We brought the crew in and we knocked the cover off the box.
sentences.zh: 我们带上工作人员，敲开了盒子的盖子。

sentences.en: So Russ says he and his crew were opening it.
sentences.zh: 拉斯说他和他的团队当时正在打开它。

sentences.en: And inside the box, there is another box.
sentences.zh: 盒子里还有另一个盒子。

sentences.en: And the second box, it's velvet.
sentences.zh: 第二个盒子是天鹅绒材质的。

sentences.en: And the second box was not a normal box.
sentences.zh: 而且第二个盒子不是普通的盒子。

sentences.en: It was more like a puzzle box.
sentences.zh: 它更像是一个益智盒。

sentences.en: Like you had to flip a bunch of switches and stuff to get it open.
sentences.zh: 就像你得拨动一堆开关之类的东西才能把它打开。

sentences.en: The box opened by swinging the sides out and up and all of that.
sentences.zh: 打开这个盒子需要把侧面翻转出来再向上掀开，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And then the box opened.
sentences.zh: 然后盒子就打开了。

sentences.en: And when we opened the box, a whole bunch of gray powder came out, right?
sentences.zh: 当我们打开盒子时，一大堆灰色粉末涌了出来，对吧？

sentences.en: And everybody's like, oh, man, what is that?
sentences.zh: 大家都说，天哪，那是什么？

sentences.en: So people are, you know, clearing out this gray powder.
sentences.zh: 所以人们都在清理这些灰色粉末。

sentences.en: The dust is settling.
sentences.zh: 灰尘渐渐落定。

sentences.en: And then they look, and inside the box, they see a crystal skull.
sentences.zh: 然后他们往里一看，发现盒子里有一个水晶头骨。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: So it's a crystal skull.
sentences.zh: 所以那是一个水晶头骨。

sentences.en: It's about the size of a fiSt.
sentences.zh: 大约拳头大小。

sentences.en: Looks expensive.
sentences.zh: 看起来很贵。

sentences.en: It's like, I guess the best comparison.
sentences.zh: 我想最好的类比大概是这样。

sentences.en: Roman, have you seen a bottle of Dan Aykroyd's vodka before?
sentences.zh: 罗曼，你见过丹·艾克罗伊德的伏特加酒瓶吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没见过。

sentences.en: I can't say I've had the pleasure.
sentences.zh: 我不敢说我有幸见过。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, look, he sells vodka and a crystal skull.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你看，他卖的伏特加酒瓶就是个水晶头骨。

sentences.en: It's not terribly complicated.
sentences.zh: 这并不复杂。

sentences.en: Anyway, OK, so nobody knows what to make of this.
sentences.zh: 总之，好吧，没人知道该怎么处理这东西。

sentences.en: They're like, what is this?
sentences.zh: 他们都在想，这是什么鬼？

sentences.en: So it turns out Isaac Tigret had put it up there, apparently on the advice of a religious guru he was following who told him it would bring good luck to the pyramid.
sentences.zh: 结果发现是艾萨克·蒂格雷特把它放在那里的，显然是听从了他追随的一位宗教大师的建议，对方告诉他这会给金字塔带来好运。

sentences.en: I have to be honest, the details on this are a little sketchy.
sentences.zh: 老实说，关于这件事的细节有点模糊。

sentences.en: I reached out to Isaac Tigret to talk about the story.
sentences.zh: 我联系了艾萨克·蒂格雷特想聊聊这个故事。

sentences.en: He did not get back to me.
sentences.zh: 他没有回复我。

sentences.en: I'm sure he gets requests about this all the time.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定他一直都会收到关于这件事的询问。

sentences.en: But after this, they weren't sure what to do with the skull.
sentences.zh: 但在这之后，他们不知道该怎么处理这个头骨。

sentences.en: So it ended up in a vault in the Shelby County administration office.
sentences.zh: 所以它最终被存放在谢尔比县行政办公室的一个保险库里。

sentences.en: And Isaac Tigrett gets wind of this.
sentences.zh: 后来艾萨克·蒂格雷特听说了这件事。

sentences.en: And actually, through his mother, he managed to broker a deal.
sentences.zh: 实际上，通过他母亲的斡旋，他成功达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: And in the end, he got the skull back from the county.
sentences.zh: 最终，他从县政府那里拿回了头骨。

sentences.en: Wow, this is so dramatic.
sentences.zh: 哇，这太戏剧性了。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，确实。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like everything in this story.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这就像这个故事里的每一件事一样。

sentences.en: It is just very dramatic.
sentences.zh: 简直太戏剧化了。

sentences.en: So, of course, the media gets a hold of this, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，媒体当然抓住了这一点，对吧？

sentences.en: And they publish a bunch of stories with headlines like Crystal Skull found at the pyramids, you know, belongs to Isaac Tigrett.
sentences.zh: 他们发布了一堆新闻，标题诸如“在金字塔发现水晶头骨，属于艾萨克·蒂格雷特”。

sentences.en: And you may remember Alex Jones was involved with all this.
sentences.zh: 你可能还记得亚历克斯·琼斯也卷入了这一切。

sentences.en: He had said the pyramid was demonic.
sentences.zh: 他说金字塔是邪恶的。

sentences.en: And this is the reason why.
sentences.zh: 这就是原因所在。

sentences.en: It's because he heard about the crystal skull.
sentences.zh: 因为他听说了水晶头骨的事。

sentences.en: And that's the reason it became the center of this conspiracy theory.
sentences.zh: 这就是它成为阴谋论核心的原因。

sentences.en: Jones' so-called facts are mostly slanderous in the Internet video entitled Devil Pyramid Rotting in Memphis.
sentences.zh: 琼斯在一段名为《腐烂在孟菲斯的魔鬼金字塔》的网络视频中，所谓的“事实”大多是诽谤。

sentences.en: But at least one of his statements is true.
sentences.zh: 但至少他的一项陈述是真的。

sentences.en: A crystal skull was discovered.
sentences.zh: 确实发现了一个水晶头骨。

sentences.en: Like everything with the Memphis Pyramid, you know, it's a completely unexpected twist and turn in the story.
sentences.zh: 就像孟菲斯金字塔的所有事情一样，你知道，这是故事中完全意想不到的转折。

sentences.en: I got to say, this is definitely one of the more unpredictable ones I've ever covered for the show.
sentences.zh: 我得说，这绝对是我为节目报道过的最不可预测的故事之一。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个故事。

sentences.en: Well, thank you so much, Chris.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢你，克里斯。

sentences.en: And thank you for venturing out to Memphis.
sentences.zh: 也感谢你冒险前往孟菲斯。

sentences.en: So I grew up in Memphis.
sentences.zh: 我是在孟菲斯长大的。

sentences.en: So this is very exciting for me to hear more about Memphis.
sentences.zh: 所以能听到更多关于孟菲斯的事情让我感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: So thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: It's my pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: I hope I did your hometown justice with the story.
sentences.zh: 希望我用这个故事公正地呈现了你的家乡。

sentences.en: You certainly did.
sentences.zh: 你确实做到了。
